QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_26

question.text: Under SEBI's operational guidelines (Box 7.3), what is the nomenclature distinction between a 'Benchmark Report' and a 'Performance Report'?

answer.text: Benchmark Report is for Cat I/II; Performance Report is for Cat III.
Benchmark Report covers only IRR; Performance Report covers only multiples.
Benchmark Report is the standard report generated by the Benchmarking Agency on SEBI mandate; Performance Report is a customised, fee-based report requested by an AIF.
Benchmark Report is in USD; Performance Report is in INR.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Box 7.3 Section B(v): 'Customized performance reports thus generated shall be called Performance Report as against the nomenclature Benchmark Report, which shall be used for the standard benchmark reports generated based on SEBI mandate.' Customised reports require express consent of included AIFs and can be fee-based. The Trap: Category split (A) is fabricated. Metric split (B) is not the distinction. Currency (D) — both must be in INR and USD. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests identical distinction. Knowing the nomenclature matters when a marketing team wants to cite a peer-group chart — only custom 'Performance Reports' allow peer-group carve-outs. Manager's Pro-Tip: If pitching your fund against a peer carve-out (say, 'top 5 India Tech Growth Cat II vintage 2020'), commission a paid Performance Report with express consent from peers — distributing uncustomised Benchmark Report data for marketing can breach confidentiality terms.
